title: Tuckman's stages of group development
caption: Groups move from polite uncertainty through conflict to agreed ways of working, then performance; the fifth stage, added in 1977, is when the group disbands.
alt: Five boxes in order: forming, storming, norming, performing, adjourning.
description: Forming: polite, uncertain, dependent on the leader.
Storming: conflict over roles, goals and leadership.
Norming: agreed ways of working and growing cohesion.
Performing: focus on the task with high trust.
